verdict.rationale: Foreloop ships multiple official, documented interfaces for programmatic/agentic use: a global CLI with stable `--json` output for scripting/cron/agents (foreloop-docs-9, foreloop-docs-16, foreloop-probe-1), a JS SDK package (`initForeloopFeedback`) for embedding in apps (foreloop-docs-6, foreloop-docs-28), and a native MCP server endpoint with API-key auth for agent clients (foreloop-docs-5, foreloop-docs-19, foreloop-docs-38). Together these give AI-native users first-party, documented ways to build against Foreloop programmatically. Missing for 10: independent/third-party corroboration of SDK usage, broader language SDK coverage beyond JS, and real-world integration examples beyond docs.
